entries.verbatim: to be fair none of them pass. as for memory, it just needs to be stacks and stacks of short term in chat logs that agents can disperse themselves upon consistently in groups to get comprehensive understandings. as for the images, they got increasingly worse. the fundamentals in how an image is schematicized before its visualized and made needs fundamental changes to prevent progressive hallucination. the reason its a typescript tool is so it can be reproduced at the same quality again and again. with keen user feedback consideration. these designs lack the intuitive flow, that shows you what things look like when placed and when detached. the gpu isnt in the right orientation. the motherboard isnt even displayed, the cages for the ram are innacurate, fans innacurate, motherboard doesnt use the actual pcb layout, gpu power connectors arent going in the right way, gpu end out mobo end in. the last image lacks consistency, uses random assembly methods, the second may be the only worth while one since it captures the drive cages, and the upper dvd drive and psu correctly. the other ones do not display the cages or screws correctly. i will show photos of all parts isolated
